data_quality.verified: daily limit-up ladder and close fields
data_quality.unavailable: Level-2 queue and intent; open fields unless imported/captured

validation_integrity.rule: a blind window may be inspected once; any retraining or rule change after inspection converts it to a development holdout
validation_integrity.next_fresh_blind_requirement: use dates strictly after 2026-08-27 and freeze code before labels are inspected

threshold_evidence.abstain_reason: validation signals 14 < 31; validation frequency outside 3-5/week; 95% Wilson lower bound < 50%

joint_execution_threshold_evidence.abstain_reason: validation executable trades 11 < 31; executable frequency outside 3-5/week

height_survival_evidence.warning: terminal height is right-tail capped and remains diagnostic until evaluated on a fresh blind period

emotion_playbook.stance: 只做可成交核心，拒绝弱分支和纯一字跟随
confirmation: 昨日涨停溢价不转负且中位股无批量核按钮
二进三/三进四至少一档维持正反馈
核心换手后收复VWAP且同题材同步
invalidation: 空间板断板并扩散至中位股
炸板率升至25%以上或跌停家数快速增加
高开无量、两次冲板不封或跌破VWAP放量

transition_evidence.method: as-of-date online Dirichlet transition forecast; no future states
